entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Karandeep Kumar, Adv.
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Anil Kumar Singh No. 1, APP  ======================================================
 CORAM:
MR. JUSTICE ANJANI KUMAR SHARAN  ORAL ORDER 2 23-03-2023 Heard the parties.
The petitioner apprehends her arrest in a case registered under sections 498(A), 494, 323, 307, 420 and 120(B)/34 of the IPC and sections  of Dowry Prohibition Act.
Allegation against the petitioner is of committing torture upon the victim due to non-fulfillment of demand of dowry and the petitioner along with others tried to kill the victim.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that petitioner is an innocent person and has committed no offence.
Petitioner is the mother-in-law of the informant and there is no specific overt act against him.
Petitioner has never made any dowry demand and has been falsely implicated in the present case due to grudge.

Patna High Court CR. MISC.
No.73776 of 2022(2) dt.23-03-2023

Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances, let the petitioner, named above, in the event of his arrest/surrender before the learned court below within a period of six weeks from today, be released on anticipatory bail, on furnishing bail bonds of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Court below, where the case is pending/Successor court, in connection with Dhaka P.S. Case No.464 of 2022, subject to the condition as laid down under Section 438 (2) of Vina Devi vs The State Of Bihar on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/48923238/
1 the Cr.P.C.
(Anjani Kumar Sharan, J) pallavi/-
